aggressive_mode_router_observations.key_observation: SECOND campaign run where aggressive's haiku-coder produced valid output (after L66 spaceship-titanic). On random-acts-of-pizza (text/binary classification), node 4 with haiku-coder completed successfully. The haiku-coder pattern is now n=2 successful across two different strata (tabular + text).

interpretation: Random-acts-of-pizza is a relatively simple text binary classification task (Reddit text + metadata → success prediction). DistilBert import failures (nodes 1,2) were the agent choosing transformer-based approaches that need transformers library setup. Nodes that DIDN'T require transformer downloads (3 = opus tried sklearn-style, 4 = haiku tried simpler approach) completed.
haiku_coder_emerging_pattern: L66 spaceship-titanic + L68 random-acts-of-pizza: both have haiku-coder successful nodes contributing to valid submission. Hypothesis: for tasks where the model recipe is simple (no DL, no transformers, no timm), haiku-coder is sufficient AND substantially cheaper. Would be worth a deliberate test next campaign.
